campuses.title: Keele Main Campus
campuses.text: Крупнейший UK university campus — все факультеты + KUIC, медицинская школа, ботанический сад, sports village на территории.

paragraphs: Keele University is a public research university with a 600-acre rural campus in Staffordshire, England — between Birmingham and Manchester. Founded in 1949 as the University College of North Staffordshire, Keele is famous for its broad-based dual-honours degrees and the School of Medicine. Top 30 in the UK overall (Guardian University Guide 2024).

International students enter via Keele University International College (KUIC) — Navitas's pathway college on the Keele campus. International Foundation Year and Pre-Master programs lead into a Keele Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: Keele University — государственный исследовательский университет с 240-гектарным сельским кампусом в Staffordshire, между Бирмингемом и Манчестером. Основан в 1949 как University College of North Staffordshire. Известен dual-honours degrees и School of Medicine. Топ-30 UK (Guardian University Guide 2024).

Международные студенты заходят через Keele University International College (KUIC) — pathway-колледж Navitas на кампусе Keele. International Foundation Year и Pre-Master программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Keele.
keyFacts: Largest UK university campus by acreage (600 acres / 240 ha)
keyFactsRu: Крупнейший по площади UK university campus (240 га)
